decisions.reason: As a cutting and creasing finisher close to the core postpress range and given its own product page, it fits the firm's portfolio and is likely to stay.
Although more distant from the established offer, the prominent home-page launch and Germany-premiere positioning suggest a serious growth move worth continuing for now.
A sheet preparation module builds directly on the firm's automation-focused finishing workflow, so it is likely to be retained.
The new B2 multifinisher was highlighted on the home page and strongly matches the firm's promise of format flexibility and integrated finishing, making withdrawal unlikely.
A hybrid saddle stitcher is close to the existing booklet-making and binding business, so it should remain part of the range unless demand clearly disappoints.
This folding add-on unit complements installed equipment and already showed a concrete customer application, which supports keeping it on the market.
